title: Practical lower bounds for hybrid quantum interior point methods in linear programming
summary: Quantum interior point methods (QIPMs) promise polynomial speed-ups over classical solvers for linear programming by outsourcing the solution of Newton linear systems to quantum linear solvers (QLSAs). However, asymptotic speed-ups do not necessarily translate to practical advantages on realistic problem instances.
